header.title: L.Kairo J.E. 96810 (L.Ahmose-Henut-Tjemehu): AI translation (Claude)
header.author: Book of the Dead
header.source: Translated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) from the library's urn:egy:tla:tb:l-kairo-j-e-96810-l-ahmose-henut-tjemehu:translit, from the Thesaurus Linguae Aegyptiae (2018), in Simon Schweitzer's AED-TEI (CC BY-SA 4.0), one English line for each line of the original. Only some passages are translated so far: those that the Atlas of Ancient Myth, Magic in the Ancient Texts and the demons-and-angels study cite.
header.statement: An AI-generated translation. No specialist has reviewed it.

notes.39.1: rerek is a snake demon. Line 2: zb{t}j is marked doubtful by the editor; read as zbj 'rebel', as in line 6. Line 4: jm,j.t zꜣ[w]=k, 'in which is your guarding', is uncertain. Line 7: mds sšp=f, 'keen is his light', is uncertain; mds may refer to a knife. Line 13: jm,j.w wꜣ,t, 'those on the road', is plural; how it attaches is unclear. Line 15: ꜥḏ is untranslated; gꜣḥ 'weary' and nzp 'wounds' are uncertain readings, and the line is broken.

nodes.text: Spell for repelling the *rerek*-snake in the necropolis, by [...]
Back, you who slither, you who are bound, O Apophis, the rebel(?)!
Drown in the lakes of Nun, at the place where your father ordered that your slaughter be carried out!
Be far from that birthplace of Ra, which is under your guard.
I am [Ra], who is in his protection.
Ra has made your words fall.
Your face is turned back by the gods.
Your heart is cut out by Mafdet.
Your bonds are put on by Hededet.
Injury is inflicted on him by Maat.
She fells you for those who are on the way.
Fall, slither, Apophis, enemy of Ra!
Depart! The one who is ... in the east of the sky at the sound of the roaring storm-cloud [...] the gates of the horizon before Ra, as he goes forth weary from wounds(?).
I do as you wish, I do as you wish.
